propositions: Four LLM criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must transition from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50) based on code-v3 corpus analysis of 1760 sidecars with >=0.83 validity and high precision

Three governance-pin tests must be updated to assert an approved blocking set of exactly 7 members (security, secret-detection, high-critical-security, plus the 4 newly-blocking criteria) to enforce deliberate re-approval for any future blocking criterion additions

Regression and error-handling must be added as base-reviewer dimension entries in criteria_routing.json with inert exec/applies_to fields, consulting only default_posture/block_threshold/blocking_enabled via registry.threshold_for

The packaged criteria_routing.json changes must land before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) captures its immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden, or S1 must explicitly include these thresholds in its approved baseline
